press_references.value: Hyperbound Launches Kota: AI Sales Performance Agent to Transform B2B Sales Coaching

product_launches.description: Hyperbound launched Kota, an AI sales performance agent within its platform to analyze sales conversations, surface coaching insights, and power personalized roleplay scenarios for B2B sales teams.

overview_description.description:
Hyperbound pioneered AI Sales Roleplay technology and is the trailblazer behind the AI Sales Roleplay category for mid-market/enterprise revenue teams.

We provide human-like roleplays with AI buyers customized for your ICP, giving reps more at-bats and leveling up their business acumen in half the amount of time. 

We then inspect live calls to certify that reps are mirroring your top performers and generate personalized AI feedback and targeted roleplays to tackle performance gaps. 

The goal is faster ramp times, more pipeline, higher win rates, increased ACVs, more consistent performance across your team, and more time for your managers.

Interested in trying it out today? Start a free demo simulation at hyperbound.ai and contact us at founders@hyperbound.ai for next steps.

product.name: Hyperbound Practice
product.description: An AI sales role-play and coaching platform that simulates buyer conversations, evaluates reps against customizable scorecards, and provides feedback for improving sales skills.

product.name: Hyperbound Perform
product.description: A real-call analysis and deal-coaching product that scores sales conversations, identifies execution gaps, and generates targeted actions and role-plays for active opportunities.

product.name: Kota Activate
product.description: An AI sales performance agent that analyzes call, email, CRM, role-play, and deal data to answer questions, identify risks, recommend coaching, and automate revenue workflows.

product.name: Enterprise Implementation Services
product.description: Professional onboarding and implementation support for configuring Hyperbound, building role-play bots and scorecards, connecting enterprise systems, and deploying the platform across revenue teams.
